_comment: AER-679 moving-position pass threshold, narrowed by AER-1082. svs.frame_gap_ms.p95 stays gated at 50 ms == PROBE_GAP_WARN_MS (map/perf.py) -- cross-checked against AER-677's own measurement, healthy SVS gap ~25 ms (40 fps) vs the reproduced defect's ~699 ms (1.4 fps), so 50 ms sits with clean margin above healthy and two orders of magnitude below the defect. map.frame_gap_ms.p95 is NOT gated: AER-692 showed it is dominated by pose-quantization arithmetic (10 NM half-range, 130 kt -> ~266 ms to cross the half-pixel the pose gate requires, then a 10 Hz frame-clock boundary on top), so ~300 ms is the CORRECT designed answer for that scenario and a 50 ms bound on it is always-red regardless of code health. The map is instead gated on map.probe.p95_ms -- GuiProbe's own tick-to-tick wall-clock gap against its 10 ms timer, the objective GIL-starvation detector, insensitive to pose quantization (measured p50 9.7 / p95 10.9 / max 13.6 ms in the very run that read 205 ms of frame gap). 50 ms is PROBE_GAP_WARN_MS itself here, not borrowed. See docs/moving_map_spec.md section 9.2.
